description:
Nestled on a quiet cul-de-sac south of the boulevard in highly desirable Woodland Hills, this exceptional property offers comfort, style, and incredible versatility. The main residence welcomes you with a charming front porch entry leading into a light-filled interior featuring 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. The beautifully remodeled kitchen offers ample space, a cozy breakfast nook, and flows seamlessly into the formal dining room. The inviting living room showcases a fireplace, abundant natural light, and pleasant views. Gorgeous wood flooring, recessed lighting throughout, and newer central A/C enhance the home’s warmth and modern appeal.
Outside brings a spacious backyard featuring a patio area and endless possibilities to create your dream outdoor retreat. A newer storage shed is included for additional storage, along with a two-car garage.

Adding even more value to this special property is a detached studio ADU with excellent income-producing potential. Complete with a full kitchen, spacious bathroom, and in-unit washer and dryer, this flexible space offers an outstanding opportunity for rental income, guest accommodations, or a private home office.

This is a must-see property with endless possibilities in one of Woodland Hills’ most sought-after neighborhoods. Property is being sold in as-is condition. Don’t miss the opportunity to tour this incredible home before it’s gone!
